# Huy Bui

> Technical consultant & Full-stack engineer based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Loves building tools and products, with experience in insurance, healthcare and e-commerce. Specialises in low-code product builders, workflow orchestration and shipping with AI in the loop.

## Current role

Senior Software Engineer / Squad Lead at CoverGo (insurance, 2024—now). Leads and builds the low-code product builder that lets insurers configure health, life, property and casualty products, a core part of the distribution platform.

- Cut time-to-market for a new insurance product from a month to a week.
- Delivered data anonymisation and deletion modules (configuration, scheduling, reporting, UI) for regulatory compliance and tenant-specific data policy.
- Designed the workflow wrapper around Temporal so customer journeys and background processing compose without bespoke plumbing.
- Built customer and broker portal demos for three prospective clients; used Cursor with Claude models to speed up implementation by 40%.
- Won the 2024 Innovator Award at CoverGo for product innovation.

## Experience history

- 2024—now: Senior Software Engineer / Squad Lead, CoverGo (Insurance): Vue 3, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS, Temporal, Keycloak. See Current role.
- 2023: Technical Lead, National Innovation Center (Government): Nuxt 3, NestJS, MongoDB, WordPress, AWS, Firebase. Owned the business connect platform for Vietnam International Innovation Expo 2023, serving more than 15,000 visitors; recruited and managed a team of seven.
- 2021—2023: Senior Software Engineer, Pangara AB (Platform/CMS): Vue.js, Node.js, Directus, Laravel, MySQL. Built a platform and no-code extensions on Directus; cut project development time from two weeks to three days.
- 2020—2021: Team Leader, ICD Vietnam (E-commerce): Node.js, TypeScript, Express, Angular, Google App Engine. Led five engineers on a Japanese hypermarket group's e-commerce platform; cut a 32M-record data export from four hours to one and releases from four hours to thirty minutes.
- 2018—2020: Solution Architect & Pre-sale, FPT Software (Healthcare): PHP CodeIgniter, Vue.js, Laravel, Node.js, AWS Serverless, Swift. Secured two $1M contracts (Korean dental company, Japanese PHR project); led four proofs of concept for Medical IT Expo Japan; trained more than fifty developers.
- 2016—2018: Senior Software Engineer, NTT DATA (Healthcare): Java, Spring MVC, Oracle, Terasoluna. Led the MS SQL to Oracle migration for icashica.com, taking query time from ten seconds to one.
- 2015: Software Programmer, FPT Information System (Enterprise/SAP): SAP ABAP. Technical documentation at 100% compliance with design review standards.

## Selected projects

- Government Event Website & Registration (https://hanoiconvention.org): CMS and online registration for the UN Convention against Cybercrime signing ceremony in Hanoi. WordPress, Next.js, NestJS, K8s.
- Booking & Reservation Module (https://kasha.io): Booking module backend, architected from inception to MVP launch. NestJS, gRPC, RabbitMQ, Postgres.
- Insurance Product Builder (https://covergo.com): Low-code builder for insurers to configure products with minimal code. Vue 3, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Keycloak.
- Breezing.in - Event Management Platform (https://breezing.in): All-in-one event and booking platform, built as founding engineer. Nuxt 3, NestJS, MongoDB, AWS.
- Business Connect - Matchmaking Platform (https://nic.gov.vn): Business matchmaking platform for Vietnam International Innovation Expo 2023. Nuxt 3, NestJS, MongoDB, AWS.
- Dental AI Imaging Project: AI-powered imaging tool and microservices dental platform. PHP, Vue.js, Laravel, AWS Serverless.
